title: Copilot-First Design: Smarter Power Apps Solutions with Plans and Generative Pages
summary: Plans (formerly Plan designer) scaffolds tables and apps from requirements using four agents; no flows or agents.
whyItMatters: Useful for scoping, not production builds.

keyPoints.heading: Plans
keyPoints.text: From requirements: business problem, personas, processes, data model, components, solution page. Uses 4 agents; no flows or agents generated.

anthony: Available in GCC but uses non-FedRAMP-approved sources.
Could help customers scope a problem before engaging us, or inspire our own scoping agent.
Overall session was poor; we weren't the target audience.
